about.text: A creamy starch-set milk pudding of the muhallebi family, sold in Israel from street carts with a thick syrup and toppings such as pistachio or coconut. It is made with milk or cream and cornstarch, flavoured with rose or orange-flower water and chilled to set; a pareve version uses almond milk.
